title: Exclusive Island of Orleans Food & Drink Tour in an ID. Buzz
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the culinary treasures of Île d’Orléans in a private Volkswagen ID. Buzz, guided by a local expert. Start your journey at the Chocolaterie de l’Île d’Orléans, indulging in handcrafted chocolates, then savor craft beers at the Microbrasserie de l’Île d’Orléans. At Domaine Sainte-Famille, enjoy a gourmet charcuterie and cheese board alongside premium wine tasting in a serene orchard. Experience cider and gin tastings at Verger Bilodeau before capping off your tour with locally crafted wines at Vignoble Bacchus, all while soaking in stunning views of the St. Lawrence River. This exclusive tour is tailored for your group, ensuring a relaxed and personalized experience.

- Private transportation in a premium Volkswagen ID. Buzz
- Hotel pick-up and drop-off included in Québec City
- Professional local driver-guide fluent in English or French
- Enjoy tastings of chocolates, beers, wines, ciders, and gourmet snacks
